defects_found.description: corpus-turn.yml's commit step assumed LAST-TURN.json exists; dry mode never writes it (run #1 exit 128).
defects_found.root_cause: the commit step was written for apply mode and never executed in dry mode before landing (this sandbox cannot run the workflow)

defects_found.description: GitHub Actions cannot open the turn/sweep PRs: 'GitHub Actions is not permitted to create or approve pull requests'.
defects_found.root_cause: repository setting Settings -> Actions -> General -> 'Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests' is off; the workflows assumed the default-on state of a fresh repo. The classifier blocks this session from the Settings page; operator action.
defects_found.fix_ref: both workflows now print the compare URL and name the setting on failure; PRs #509 and this train opened by hand

defects_found.description: The discipline memory gate classifies fsi-app/scripts/** as code, so an automated turn PR (run records only) can never pass it.
defects_found.root_cause: the gate predates any machine-emitted commit under scripts/
defects_found.fix_ref: .github/workflows/discipline.yml memory gate exclusion for scripts/harness-runs/** and scripts/turns/LAST-TURN.json

defects_found.description: forward-events-run-002's full_trace_refs point at /tmp on an ephemeral runner; its 276 skip reasons are unreadable from the repo.
defects_found.root_cause: corpus-turn.yml passed /tmp paths to run-extraction.mjs and only uploaded scripts/_snapshots/
defects_found.fix_ref: corpus-turn.yml: corpus + events + skipped under scripts/_snapshots/turn-<run_id>/ (retained 90 days by the existing upload step)

defects_found.description: walkEurlexOj reports 31-32 'extracted' links per day for a 2-act edition: extractPortalLinks's generic INSTRUMENT_RE accepts the daily view's navigation chrome.
defects_found.root_cause: a portal-homepage harvester reused unfiltered on a register page of known shape

defects_found.description: EUR-Lex serves the last published edition for a weekend ojDate; the walker re-extracted 28 Aug on 29 and 30 Aug and counted it as those days' enumeration.
defects_found.root_cause: the walker's own header assumed weekends 404 ('a register day can 404 on weekends'); the site redirects instead
defects_found.fix_ref: register-walk.mjs duplicate_of detection (identical act-set within one walk); test

defects_found.description: source-sweep-run-001 stamps started_at at finish time and has no finished_at; its dry verdicts say 'upserted' for 0 writes; its raw result carries counts only (no URLs) and was written as a family-level *.json that F28 rejects as an invalid artifact.
defects_found.root_cause: the driver was authored in a sandbox that could not run it (PENDING-RUN.md's own admission); first execution exposed all four
defects_found.fix_ref: run-source-sweep.mjs: startedAt before try, finished_at in finally, shapeRunOutput(mode), defaultTraceDir; register-walk.mjs per-day urls; run-001 trace moved to traces/; CONVENTION.md; 3 tests

defects_found.description: apply-extraction-output.mjs contained a raw NUL byte as the dedupe-key separator; grep reported 'binary file matches'.
defects_found.root_cause: a control character typed into source instead of its escape
defects_found.fix_ref: \u0000 escape, same runtime value; 16 tests still pass

proposer_notes: The named runtime works: four workflow dispatches reached the database and the public web, one full apply turn landed real flywheel state through the guarded path, and every run left an artifact. Reading those artifacts against reality (the live EUR-Lex page, run-001's metrics, the Actions logs) found eight defects, seven of them authored in a sandbox that could not execute the code they were in, which is the exact failure mode PENDING-RUN.md markers exist to declare. Dry-first prevented every wrong write. The one item this session cannot close is the repository setting that lets Actions open its own PRs; until the operator flips it, every turn and sweep needs a hand-opened PR from the compare URL the workflow now prints. Next proposer pass: source-sweep-run-002 (dry re-walk, expected days_duplicate_edition=2 and single-digit acts per weekday) discharges the source-sweep marker; then the first apply walk; then the skip-reason histogram proposed in forward-events/LAST-PROPOSER-PASS.md.
